---
title: "Co-authors"
subtitle: "A small network analysis of my publications"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| label: data
library(yaml)
library(igraph)
library(jsonlite)

ego  <- "A. Bar-Hen"
pubs <- yaml::read_yaml("publications.yml")

# Authors of each publication (truncated lists "et al." are kept as given)
authors_of <- function(p) {
  a <- trimws(strsplit(p$authors, ",")[[1]])
  a <- a[!a %in% c("", "et al.", "…", "...")]
  unique(a)
}
pub_df <- data.frame(
  year     = vapply(pubs, function(p) as.integer(p$year), 1L),
  type     = vapply(pubs, function(p) p$categories[[1]], ""),
  n_auth   = vapply(pubs, function(p) length(authors_of(p)), 1L)
)
auth_list <- lapply(pubs, function(p) setdiff(authors_of(p), ego))

# One row per (publication, co-author)
links <- do.call(rbind, Map(function(a, y, i) {
  if (length(a)) data.frame(pub = i, author = a, year = y) else NULL
}, auth_list, pub_df$year, seq_along(pubs)))

co <- aggregate(pub ~ author, data = links, FUN = length)
names(co)[2] <- "papers"
co$first <- aggregate(year ~ author, data = links, FUN = min)$year
co$last  <- aggregate(year ~ author, data = links, FUN = max)$year
co <- co[order(-co$papers, co$author), ]

# Co-author graph (without me): an edge joins two co-authors of a same paper
pairs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(auth_list, function(a) {
  if (length(a) < 2) return(NULL)
  m <- t(combn(sort(a), 2)); data.frame(from = m[, 1], to = m[, 2])
}))
pairs$weight <- 1
pairs <- aggregate(weight ~ from + to, data = pairs, FUN = sum)
g_all <- graph_from_data_frame(pairs, directed = FALSE,
                               vertices = data.frame(name = co$author))

# Displayed network: co-authors with at least 2 joint papers
min_papers <- 2
keep <- co$author[co$papers >= min_papers]
g <- induced_subgraph(g_all, keep)
set.seed(1)
comm <- cluster_louvain(g, weights = E(g)$weight)
memb <- membership(comm)
btw  <- betweenness(g, weights = 1 / E(g)$weight, normalized = TRUE)

# Name each community after its most frequent co-author
papers_of <- setNames(co$papers, co$author)
comm_ids  <- sort(unique(memb))
comm_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(comm_ids, function(k) {
  m <- names(memb)[memb == k]
  m <- m[order(-papers_of[m], m)]
  data.frame(id = k, size = length(m), lead = m[1],
             members = paste(m, collapse = ", "),
             papers = sum(papers_of[m]))
}))
comm_info <- comm_info[order(-comm_info$size, -comm_info$papers), ]
comm_info$rank <- seq_len(nrow(comm_info))
groups  <- comm_info[comm_info$size >= 2, ]
singles <- comm_info[comm_info$size == 1, ]

stats <- list(
  pubs        = length(pubs),
  years       = paste(min(pub_df$year), max(pub_df$year), sep = "–"),
  coauthors   = nrow(co),
  repeat_co   = sum(co$papers >= 2),
  solo        = sum(pub_df$n_auth == 1),
  median_auth = median(pub_df$n_auth),
  shown       = vcount(g),
  edges       = ecount(g),
  components  = components(g)$no,
  communities = nrow(groups),
  singles     = nrow(singles),
  modularity  = round(modularity(comm), 2)
)

bridges <- head(sort(btw, decreasing = TRUE), 5)

per_year <- as.data.frame(table(factor(pub_df$year,
  levels = seq(min(pub_df$year), max(pub_df$year)))), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(per_year) <- c("year", "n")
per_year$year <- as.integer(per_year$year)

nodes <- data.frame(
  id     = V(g)$name,
  papers = unname(papers_of[V(g)$name]),
  first  = co$first[match(V(g)$name, co$author)],
  last   = co$last[match(V(g)$name, co$author)],
  comm   = comm_info$rank[match(memb[V(g)$name], comm_info$id)],
  btw    = round(unname(btw[V(g)$name]), 3)
)
edges <- igraph::as_data_frame(g, what = "edges")
```

```{r}
#| label: payload
#| output: asis
payload <- list(
  nodes = nodes, edges = edges, perYear = per_year,
  top = head(co, 15),
  communities = comm_info[, c("rank", "size", "lead", "members")],
  nGroups = nrow(groups)
)
cat('<script>window.COAUTH = ', toJSON(payload, dataframe = "rows", auto_unbox = TRUE), ';</script>\n', sep = "")
```

## The co-author network

Each node is a co-author with at least `r min_papers` joint papers (`r stats$shown` people); two co-authors are linked when they signed a paper together, and thicker links mean more joint papers. I am left out, since I am connected to everybody. Node size reflects the number of papers we wrote together. Hover a node for details, drag to explore, scroll to zoom.

::: {.column-page}
::: {#viz-net .viz-root}
:::
:::

::: {#viz-comm .viz-root}
:::

### What the network says

- Apart from me, the co-authors form **`r stats$communities` groups** of two people or more (Louvain algorithm, modularity `r stats$modularity`), plus `r stats$singles` co-authors with no other link: the network is made of research collaborations that hardly overlap.
- The largest groups gather around `r paste(head(groups$lead, 6), collapse = ", ")`.
- The co-authors who act most as **bridges** inside the network (highest betweenness) are `r paste(names(bridges), collapse = ", ")`.
- `r stats$solo` publications are single-authored; half of the papers have `r stats$median_auth` authors or fewer.

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal"}
Computed automatically from the [publications list](publications.qmd) each time the site is built, with R ([igraph](https://r.igraph.org/)). Author lists truncated with "et al." only include the first authors. Inspired by [Eric Marcon's bibliometrics page](https://ericmarcon.github.io/Bibliometrie/Bibliometrie.html).
:::
